title.en: Who says what in a meeting
title.es: Quién dice qué en una reunión

es: Identificar quién dirige, quién anota y qué función cumple cada intervención en una reunión de vecinos.

teaching.en: Whoever agrees to chair the meeting should open the session, read out each item on the agenda in order and give every member a fair turn to speak.
teaching.es: Quien acepta presidir la reunión debe abrir la sesión, leer cada punto del orden del día por orden y dar a cada miembro un turno justo para hablar.
teaching.explanationEs: Chair the meeting: abrir, dar turnos y cerrar. Item es cada punto del orden del día (agenda).
segments: Whoever agrees to chair the meeting should open the session, read out each item
on the agenda in order and give every member a fair turn to speak.
teaching.audioText: Whoever agrees to chair the meeting should open the session, read out each item on the agenda in order and give every member a fair turn to speak.

teaching.en: The secretary writes the minutes while the discussion is still going on, so that anyone who missed the session can see what was decided and by whom.
teaching.es: La secretaria redacta el acta mientras la discusión sigue en marcha, para que quien faltó a la sesión pueda ver qué se decidió y quién lo decidió.
teaching.explanationEs: Minutes es el acta escrita, nunca «minutos» en este contexto.
segments: The secretary writes the minutes while the discussion is still going on, so that
anyone who missed the session can see what was decided and by whom.
teaching.audioText: The secretary writes the minutes while the discussion is still going on, so that anyone who missed the session can see what was decided and by whom.

teaching.en: If a speaker begins to digress, the chair may politely steer the discussion back by saying that the new point belongs under a different item.
teaching.es: Si alguien empieza a divagar, quien preside puede reconducir la discusión con educación diciendo que el nuevo punto pertenece a otro apartado.
teaching.explanationEs: Digress: salirse del tema. Steer back: devolver la conversación a su cauce.
segments: If a speaker begins to digress, the chair may politely steer the discussion
back by saying that the new point belongs under a different item.
teaching.audioText: If a speaker begins to digress, the chair may politely steer the discussion back by saying that the new point belongs under a different item.

teaching.en: Members who wish to take the floor should wait to be recognised, because it is considered rude to interrupt a colleague who is still speaking.
teaching.es: Los miembros que quieran tomar la palabra deben esperar a que se les conceda, porque se considera de mala educación interrumpir a un compañero que aún habla.
teaching.explanationEs: Take the floor: empezar a hablar con el permiso de la presidencia.
segments: Members who wish to take the floor should wait to be recognised, because
it is considered rude to interrupt a colleague who is still speaking.
teaching.audioText: Members who wish to take the floor should wait to be recognised, because it is considered rude to interrupt a colleague who is still speaking.

teaching.en: Sorry to interrupt, but could I clarify one point before the chair decides to call for a vote on the proposal?
teaching.es: Perdona que interrumpa, pero ¿podría aclarar un punto antes de que la presidencia decida pedir que se vote la propuesta?
teaching.explanationEs: Sorry to + verbo base pide permiso; could I clarify suaviza la petición; call for a vote somete algo a votación.
segments: Sorry to interrupt, but could I clarify one point before the
chair decides to call for a vote on the proposal?
teaching.audioText: Sorry to interrupt, but could I clarify one point before the chair decides to call for a vote on the proposal?

teaching.en: Once the debate is over, any member may propose a motion, and the chair will call for a vote only after somebody has seconded it.
teaching.es: Cuando termina el debate, cualquier miembro puede proponer una moción, y la presidencia pedirá la votación solo después de que alguien la secunde.
teaching.explanationEs: Propose a motion abre una propuesta formal; la votación llega cuando alguien la apoya (second).
segments: Once the debate is over, any member may propose a motion, and the
chair will call for a vote only after somebody has seconded it.
teaching.audioText: Once the debate is over, any member may propose a motion, and the chair will call for a vote only after somebody has seconded it.

prompt.es: Lee la intervención de Ana en el acta. ¿Qué función cumple?

choices.text: She opens the session and explains how the evening will run.
She proposes a motion and asks the members to decide on it today.
She interrupts a speaker to correct something said earlier.

feedback.es: Ana saluda, presenta el orden del día y asigna el acta: abre la sesión, tarea propia de quien preside. No propone ni interrumpe.

hint.es: Piensa en qué hace quien preside al comenzar, antes de que nadie haya hablado.

origin.text: Ana: Good evening, everyone. Before we begin, let me remind you that we have three items on the agenda tonight and that Sara will write the minutes. Let's start with the new bench.

prompt.es: Completa: «Leo, creo que te estás saliendo del tema de este punto.»

feedback.es: Digress from es la colocación para apartarse del tema principal: lo que hace Leo al contar sus vacaciones.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa salirse del tema; tras to va la forma base.

origin.text: Leo has been describing his summer holiday for ten minutes now. Ana smiles and says, «Leo, I think you are starting to ___ from the item we are discussing.»

prompt.es: Ordena: «Cada miembro debe esperar a la presidencia antes de tomar la palabra.»

answer.text: Each member must wait for the chair before they take the floor

feedback.es: Take the floor es la colocación de empezar a hablar con permiso; must wait for the chair marca la obligación de esperar.

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto Each member y acaba con la colocación del turno de palabra.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo la presidencia cuando un miembro se fue por las ramas.

choices.text: She suggested a separate motion about the parking fines.
She brought the discussion back to the item in hand.
She asked the secretary to read the minutes aloud again.

feedback.es: La presidencia reconduce el debate al punto que tocaba («steered the discussion back»). Las multas de estacionamiento quedan fuera del tema.

origin.audio: At last night's residents' meeting, the chair opened the session by thanking everyone for coming and reading out the three items on the agenda. The secretary, who was writing the minutes, reminded the members that anyone wishing to take the floor should raise a hand first. Halfway through the first item, one member went off the subject and began talking about parking fines, so the chair politely steered the discussion back. A second member then proposed a motion about the bench, and, once it had been seconded, the chair asked everyone to vote.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez y elige qué ocurrió justo antes de la votación.

choices.text: The secretary read out last month's minutes.
The chair announced the end of the meeting.
Somebody backed the motion about the bench.

feedback.es: La moción sobre el banco fue secundada («had been seconded») y solo entonces se votó; el acta y el cierre no se mencionan en ese momento.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión de la reunión con su función.

pairs.es: Abrir la sesión, dar turnos y mantener el orden
Anotar lo acordado y redactar el acta

pairs: put the motion to the members

pairs.es: Someter una propuesta a la decisión de los miembros
Empezar a hablar con permiso de la presidencia

feedback.es: Cada expresión designa una función distinta: dirigir, anotar, decidir por votación y pedir turno de palabra.

prompt.es: Según el acta, ¿qué función cumple la intervención de Tom?

choices.text: He cuts in politely to ask about the cost.
He takes the floor to propose a separate motion on water.
He closes the item and moves on to the next one.

feedback.es: «Sorry to interrupt… could I clarify…?» es la fórmula de quien corta con cortesía para aclarar un dato; aquí, quién paga el agua.

origin.text: Item 2: the community garden. Mia: I would like to propose that we open the garden on Saturdays. Tom: Sorry to interrupt, Mia, but could I clarify one point? Who pays for the water? Mia: The council does. Leo: That is a fair point, but we are drifting; the water is a separate item. Ana: Thank you, Leo. Let us return to Mia's proposal and ask the members to decide.

prompt.es: En ese acta, ¿qué da a entender Leo con su comentario sobre el agua?

choices.text: That the council should not pay for the garden water.
That the water question belongs under another item.
That Mia should drop her proposal about Saturdays.

feedback.es: Leo admite que la pregunta es razonable, pero dice que es «a separate item»: pertenece a otro punto. Ana lo confirma al volver a la propuesta de Mia.

origin.text: Item 2: the community garden. Mia: I would like to propose that we open the garden on Saturdays. Tom: Sorry to interrupt, Mia, but could I clarify one point? Who pays for the water? Mia: The council does. Leo: That is a fair point, but we are drifting; the water is a separate item. Ana: Thank you, Leo. Let us return to Mia's proposal and ask the members to decide.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pretende la presidencia con este mensaje.

choices.text: To end the meeting because it has already run over time.
To postpone the decision on the motion until next month.
To limit Mia's turn politely so the meeting keeps moving.

feedback.es: La presidencia pide a Mia que concluya y da paso a Tom sin reprocharle nada: gestiona el tiempo con cortesía. Ni cierra la reunión ni aplaza la moción.

origin.audio: Right, that is the first item finished. Before we move on, may I remind everyone that we are already ten minutes over time? Mia, you have held the floor for quite a while, and Tom has been waiting patiently to speak. So, Mia, if you could wrap up in one sentence, Tom can ask his question, and after that we will put the motion to the members.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si nadie quiere añadir nada, pediré que se vote la propuesta.»

feedback.es: Call for a vote es la colocación fija para pedir que se someta algo a votación; ask for a vote también es posible, pero call for es la fórmula propia de quien preside.

origin.text: After a long and careful debate, the members agreed that the proposal was clear. The chair looked around the room and said, «If nobody wishes to add anything, I will ___ for a vote on the proposal.»

prompt.es: Según el acta, ¿qué deja claro la presidencia en su respuesta a Carlos?

choices.text: That his objection came too late to change the result.
That the vote must be repeated because of his objection.
That the secretary should remove the vote from the minutes.

feedback.es: Ana recuerda que las objeciones se plantean antes de votar: la decisión ya está tomada y se mantiene. No pide repetir la votación ni borrarla del acta.

origin.text: Minutes, item 4. Sara proposed moving the summer party to June. The members voted, and the proposal was approved. Carlos then objected that the hall would not be free that month. Ana, as chair, replied that objections must be raised before a vote, so the decision would stand.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace el hablante con su intervención.

choices.text: He proposes a motion on the parking problem.
He brings the meeting back politely to the planned item.
He asks the secretary to read back the last minutes.

feedback.es: Pide turno con cortesía y propone estacionar el otro tema para volver a lo previsto: reconduce, no propone ni pide el acta.

origin.audio: If I could just come in here for a moment, I think we may be going off the point. The agenda says the bench comes first, and the parking problem is a different matter, so perhaps we could note it down for next month and return to the bench before we run out of time.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Déjame terminar este punto y luego podrás aclarar tu pregunta.»

answer.text: Let me finish this item and then you can clarify your question

feedback.es: Quien preside controla los turnos: let me finish marca que termina primero y then you can clarify cede la palabra después.
